forbidden.name: no-circular
forbidden.comment: Break cycles by moving the shared rule to src/shared/lib/, or keep the dependency in one direction between module public APIs (Node layout).

forbidden.name: edge-no-node
forbidden.comment: The HTTP edge parses, calls a module and answers; file, process and network work belongs in the module's data/ or in src/backend/ (Node layout).

forbidden.name: domain-no-node
forbidden.comment: A domain/ rule is plain TypeScript: file, process and network work belongs in the module's data/ (Node layout).

forbidden.name: backend-from-data-only
forbidden.comment: Call the backend through the module's data/, which alone imports the client from src/backend/; elsewhere import its types with "import type" (Node layout).

forbidden.name: backend-own-code
forbidden.comment: src/backend/ holds the clients and their types only: no module or app code (Node layout).

forbidden.name: shared-not-up
forbidden.comment: Code in src/shared/ is used by every module and may import no module, app or backend client; the code that needs one belongs in src/modules/<module>/ (Node layout).

forbidden.name: module-public-api
forbidden.comment: Import another module through its index.ts; keep internal imports inside their own module (Node layout).

forbidden.name: domain-pure-path
forbidden.comment: A domain/ rule is plain TypeScript: I/O belongs in the module's data/ (Node layout).

forbidden.name: not-to-test
forbidden.comment: Keep test fixtures and assertions in colocated *.test.ts files; move reusable production logic to domain/ or src/shared/lib/ (Node layout).
